snippet.title: Beeing Hive - Trailer | GamingUp Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
Build your hive. Organize your bees. Protect your colony.

Beeing Hive is a relaxed hive-building simulation with clicker elements where you design and manage your very own beehive from the inside.

Gather resources, expand your hive comb by comb and optimize its layout as your colony continues to grow. Assign different roles to your bees and keep your buzzing little ecosystem running efficiently.

But life inside the hive isn't always peaceful. Protect your colony from wasps, moths, woodpeckers and even hungry bears as you build your hive into a thriving organism.

Wishlist Beeing Hive now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4202630/Beeing_Hive/

Play Beeing Hive at gamescom 2026 in Hall 10.2, Booth D043G.
